Game Overview

In Eclipse Run 3, the core idea is straightforward: race through an ever-changing world in Eclipse Run 3, where each environment morphs before your eyes. Strategically navigate day-to-night cycles, uncover secret shortcuts, and customize your racing experience. With intuitive controls and dynamic terrain, every race offers a fresh, exhilarating challenge that keeps you on your toes.
